Name: Customizable Slime Hutch
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]No slimeballs on the walls![/*]
[*]Wallpaper and flooring replacement support[/*]
[*]Simple exterior recolor with options for popular recolors (Earthy and VPR)[/*]
[*]Eight slime object recolors (incubator, egg press, water bowl) to fit any design[/*]
[*]Classic slime hutch size[/*]
[/list][center][/center]
[center][youtube]uF0AwxfYHxo[/youtube][/center]
[center][i]Cozy speed build in the Customizable Slime Hutch![/i][/center]


[b]✧ Compatibility ✧[/b]
If you wish to use this mod with other mods that change the exterior or interior of the slime hutch, disable that aspect in this mod so they can work together!  "Auto" value in the configuration tries to detect and match your recolor (Earthy or VPR) and for exterior also detects both Tanga's Forest buildings and Medieval buildings to auto-disable. Manual options can always be selected!

[center][youtube]5KFkxKw2h6o[/youtube]
[i]After days of sleeping, positively tested wall solution. Squishy slime balls only spawn on the floor! [/i][/center]

[b][size=3]✧ Configuration ✧[/size][/b]

[spoiler][list]
[*][b]BuildingTextureStyle:[/b] Choose your exterior building style (default: auto, basic) [/*]
[*][b]AccessoryTextureStyle:[/b] Choose accessory color style (default: auto, basic)[/*]
[*][b]MapStyle:[/b] Select your interior map style (default: custom)[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
